paite: Siampu Levite, Levi nam tengteng in Israelte lak ah tantuan leh goutan anei ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA kiang a mei a thillat leh amau a tuam pen ane ding uhi.
heading: Siampute Tan

paite: A unaute uh lak ah goutan anei ding uh ahi kei; agoutan uh bel akiang ua agen bang in TOUPA ahi ngal a.
Mipite lak a pan kithoihna lanpa siampu a tuam ding hiaite ahi: Bawngtal leh belam liang leh abiangtuai langnih leh agilpi siampu apiak ding uh ahi.
Na buh na bal, na uain, na thau tung masate uh, na belam mulmet masakpente uh leng na piak ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un TOUPA min a nasem a om tawntung ding in nam tengteng a pan amau leh atapate uh toh atel ahi ngal ua.
Levi mi kuapeuh atenna Israel gam na tenna ua akoipeuh pawtsan a, alungsim a kilawptak a TOUPA'N aseh ding mun a ahong paileh;
huai a TOUPA ma a om Levite, a-unaute mah bang in TOUPA a Pathian min in nna asem ding ahi.
Asiamput man uh sim louh in midang tuam nek ding atang sam himhim ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding gamsung a na lut chiang un, huai gam a namte thilhih kihhuaite zui kei un.
heading: Ginglou mite Thilhih Thu A Vauna

paite: Na lak uah mi kuamah atapa hiam, atanu hiam mei a paisuaksak, mi kuamah aisan ching, mi kuamah mangsan ching hiam, bum hiam, mitkhialdawi tawi hiam,
zawl aitawi hiam, mi sisa houpih hiam, khate zawl hiam, misisate dong thei hiam na om ding uh ahi kei.
Hichibang thilhih chingte peuhmah TOUPA a ding in mikihhuai ahi ngal ua. Hiai thilkihhuaite ziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un amaute ahon delhkhiaksak.
TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a na hoihkim ding uh ahi.
Huai na va luah ding uh gam a namte'n mitkhialdawi leh aisan ching mite angaikhia ua; nou zaw TOUPA na Pathian un huchibang hih ahon phal kei hi.
heading: Zawlnei Sawl Ding A Thuchiam

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un keimah bang na unaute uh lak a mi zawlnei a hon bawlsak dia, ama thu na ngaikhe ding uh ahi.
"TOUPA i Pathian aw zaw hon zasak nawn ke'nla, hiai mei thupi hon musak nawn ke'n, ka si kha ding uh," chi a Horeb tang a kikhopkhawm ni a TOUPA na Pathian uh na deihdan bang un.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, athugen uh agen hoih ngel uhi.
A-unaute uh lak ah nangmah bang zawlnei ka bawlsak dia, akam ah ka thute ka koih dia, akiang a ka thupiak peuhmah akiang uah agen ding.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka min a ka thu agen zui lou peuhmah ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
Ka min agen ding ka piak louh gen teitei zawlnei hiam, pathian dangte min a thugenmi zawlnei hiam, huai zawlnei hihlup ding ahi.
"Na lungtang ua, bangchi in ahia athu TOUPA gen ahi kei chih i theih ding? na chih uleh,

zawlnei in TOUPA min a thu agen a, athil gen pen ahong tangtun kei a, alohchin keileh, huaitak ahi, TOUPA gen louh, zawlnei in ki-uangsaktak in agen mawkmawk ahi a, amah na lau ding uh ahi kei," achi hi.
